assets.name: Sovereignty over Synchronization
assets.description: Visual representation of the rupture of legacy timekeeping.
assets.prompt: Sovereignty over Synchronization - A conceptual 3D render of a high-end mechanical clock face shattering into thousands of golden light particles (#eab308) against a deep slate 950 background. The shards represent the rupture of legacy timekeeping. Cinematic lighting, sharp focus, 3D spatial web aesthetic, Horizon Engine style.

assets.name: Fluid Adaptation
assets.description: Visual representation of decentralized node broadcasting and liquid motion.
assets.prompt: Fluid Adaptation - A shifting, procedural plasma silhouette of a dragon flowing seamlessly through a decentralized mesh network of glowing golden nodes. Deep obsidian background, liquid motion, vibrant gold energy trails, 3D holographic style. High-contrast, sovereign architecture.

assets.name: Autonomous Creation
assets.description: Visual representation of the sovereign architect and quantum-resistant patterns.
assets.prompt: Autonomous Creation - A central sovereign node pulsing in a dark void, broadcasting golden frequency ripples that form complex geometric, quantum-resistant patterns. Minimalist, elegant, high-stakes technical architecture style. Gold and deep slate palette.
